defaultValue: Choose a difficulty [before] starting a new game so it applies to every fleet.

fieldDescription: Normal uses the fleet sizes from the Fleets tab. Easy sets wandering Enigma fleets to 0.6x and scripted fleets to 0.7x. TRUE STARFARER sets wandering Enigma fleets to 1.25x and scripted fleets to 1.2x, and makes some special encounters harder. To unlock the Hellspawn background, start a new game on TRUE STARFARER, keep it for the whole game and finish the Kesteven questline.

defaultValue: These sizes apply on [Normal] difficulty only and only to fleets that spawn after a change.

fieldDescription: Size multiplier for scripted event and quest fleets. Scales only the randomly generated part of each fleet.
Size multiplier for wandering Enigma fleets. Set to 0 to stop them from spawning.

defaultValue: Finishing the Kesteven questline turns these on for all later games. You can also switch them on yourself.

fieldDescription: Makes the Throne's Gift background selectable when you start a new game with Nexerelin. Finishing the Kesteven questline turns this on.
Makes the Hellspawn background selectable when you start a new game with Nexerelin. Finishing the Kesteven questline on TRUE STARFARER turns this on.
Adds a 5 story point option to Kesteven questline conversations that skips ahead to the last part of the questline. A game that uses it can no longer unlock the Hellspawn background.
Fires the charged stasis sphere of a Stasis Generator ship you pilot while the system is cooling down. Set it to your ship system key to use one key for both.
